mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalGames, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '已完成' THEN 1 END) AS completedGames FROM user_games WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_achievements WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, ROUND(ug.play_time / 60) AS hours FROM user_games ug JOIN games g ON ug.game_id = g.id WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ug.play_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT gg.name AS name, ROUND(SUM(ug.play_time) * 100 / (SELECT SUM(play_time) FROM user_games WHERE user_id = #{userId}) ) AS percent FROM user_games ug JOIN game_genre_relations gr ON ug.game_id = gr.game_id JOIN game_genres gg ON gr.genre_id = gg.id WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY gg.name ORDER BY percent DESC
SELECT MONTH(start_time) AS month, ROUND(SUM(duration) / 60) AS hours FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(start_time) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(start_time) ORDER BY month
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yearly_reports (user_id, year, favorite_game_id, total_play_time, play_style, achievements_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{year}, #{favoriteGameId}, #{totalPlayTime}, #{playStyle}, #{achievementsCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE favorite_game_id = VALUES(favorite_game_id), total_play_time = VALUES(total_play_time), play_style = VALUES(play_style), achievements_count = VALUES(achievements_count)
